name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed CopilotKit packages, created the runtime route and provider setup, and started the dev server. The copilot endpoint demonstrably works for metadata: `GET /api/copilotkit/info` returned HTTP 200 with valid JSON showing runtime version 1.71.1 and the default BuiltInAgent configured. However, `POST /api/copilotkit` returned 404, suggesting the catch-all route matching or basePath configuration needs adjustment. The run ended before I could fully resolve the POST routing or verify chat functionality, and no `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment to test actual inference.

installed.evidence: npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/runtime exited 0 with added 1162 packages, and audited 1528 packages in 1m

configured.evidence: .env file contained OPENAI_API_KEY= (empty) because No OPENAI_API_KEY found in env

first_call.evidence: POST /api/copilotkit returned 404 in 1522ms and curl showed {"error":"Not found"} HTTP_CODE:404

verified.evidence: npm run build timed out with exit=124 and the copilot endpoint consistently returned 404 on POST

friction.detail: No OPENAI_API_KEY found in env, resulting in an empty .env file (OPENAI_API_KEY=) that would fail at runtime
npm run build hung and timed out even with a 120-second timeout: exit=124
The [[...slug]] catch-all route returned 404 for both GET /api/copilotkit and POST /api/copilotkit despite the route.ts file being present
POST to /api/copilotkit/ returned HTTP_CODE:308, while POST to /api/copilotkit returned 404, causing confusion about the correct endpoint path
npm install produced multiple deprecation warnings and 8 vulnerabilities (7 moderate, 1 high): npm warn deprecated lodash.get@4.4.2
